controller: Manual, explicitly selected experiments only; this file is not consumed by the translation conveyor.
scope: Prospective feasibility and short smoke protocol. It contains no inference results, model ranking, product approval or field acceptance.

product_effect.architecture_authority: Preserve the Rust orchestration core and Python inference-worker direction. A native Apple helper is a separate adapter, not a replacement runtime.

user_direction.preferred_mac_route: Prefer each ready Apple local capability independently; readiness is not inferred from the Mac brand or the availability of a different capability.
user_direction.notes: Use a separately configured local LLM, or report unavailable. Apple ASR, MT and system TTS do not imply a local notes model.
user_direction.other_local_fallback: Only a preconfigured local provider, with explicit actual-provider provenance. An exact-provider benchmark records failure instead of changing providers.

classifications.source_code: Behavior read at a pinned revision; not proof that an adapted executable ran.
classifications.source_metadata: Upstream repository or model-file metadata; not locally measured RAM, latency or quality.
classifications.upstream_reported: Author-reported model properties or metrics; never copied into LangTextFlow measurement fields.
classifications.locally_measured: Only a separate actual run with inputs, revisions, environment, raw results and failure accounting.
classifications.proposed: Policy or experiment specified in this plan; not evidence of implementation.
classifications.unverified: Capability or claim not established on the tested host.

preparation.purpose: Provision pinned source, dependencies, model files or Apple language assets, with no meeting audio or text.
preparation.unknown_or_incompatible_rights: Stop the affected arm and record the unresolved component; do not treat the overall repository license as a license for every asset.
preparation.apple_assets: Prepare explicitly outside the measurement session. The existing Apple MT probe only uses installed assets.

inference.input_policy: Synthetic text for initial TTS; licensed or consented nonconfidential fixtures for ASR and MT. Never use private meeting material in a public report.
inference.local_endpoint_policy: If an endpoint is necessary, verify its operator and no-upstream-proxy configuration; localhost or LAN naming alone is not proof of local inference.
inference.guard_contract: Record the actual egress controls and denied attempts. Python socket guards and offline environment variables are defense in depth, not an OS packet audit.
inference.stronger_privacy_validation: After preparation, run on a host with outbound network denied or disconnected and inspect the applicable native/subprocess paths. If not performed, mark it not verified.
inference.model_missing_or_network_attempt: Fail closed; preserve the incomplete or failed report, without fetching assets or changing providers.
inference.dependency_updates_and_release_checks: Keep outside inference timing and do not upload meeting data; such metadata traffic is distinct from remote inference.

experiment_arms.role: Audio understanding / ASR and, separately, speech-to-translated-text feasibility
experiment_arms.license_evidence_scope: Model-card declaration; not blanket dependency, asset, redistribution or deployment approval.

upstream_reported.interpretation: Active parameters are a compute-routing property, not a guarantee that only 6.5B parameters or their equivalent RAM must be resident.

source_metadata.size_scope: Checkpoint tensor-file metadata at the pinned revision; excludes any uncounted configs, tokenizer, code, runtime and temporary loading workspace.

experiment_arms.implementation_state: No local audio inference adapter is implemented by this plan.
experiment_arms.initial_phase: Metadata, rights and resource feasibility only; no full checkpoint download or CPU inference is scheduled by this JSON.
inference_gate: Pin and review the actual inference source, environment and checkpoint configuration before execution.
Confirm storage, available RAM/VRAM, loading overhead and any quantization implementation; do not infer fit from active-parameter count.
Record a suitable host and hard resource/time limits before scheduling an inference attempt.
Use an audio-to-text mode first; optional talker weights are not required merely to compare ASR.
A failed hardware or runtime prerequisite is BLOCKED_RESOURCE or BLOCKED_RUNTIME, not a model-quality result.
experiment_arms.future_first_inference_protocol: After a separate resource manifest is frozen, one short licensed clip per KO/EN/JA source, no longer than 10 seconds each, with one attempt per clip. Record ASR separately from every translation direction. No blanket 126B CPU run is authorized by this resource plan.

experiment_arms.role: Synthetic text-to-waveform smoke; not ASR, MT or caption performance
experiment_arms.rights_note: Review upstream LICENSE and preserve component notices, including Apache-origin configuration/code headers. This declaration is not a redistribution approval for every dependency or auxiliary asset.

source_metadata.size_scope: This tensor file only; auxiliary speaker-embedding model, tokenizer/config files, dependencies and runtime memory are additional.

experiment_arms.runner_status: Opt-in research harness; record its actual content hash and implementation revision at run time.

fixtures.text: Welcome. This is a local speech test.
こんにちは。ローカル音声のテストです。

protocol.repeat_rule: At most one additional whole-process attempt for a documented infrastructure/setup failure. Preserve the original failure; do not retry selectively to improve timing or waveform results.
protocol.cold_and_resident_timing: Record load time separately. Only the first synthesis is the first invocation of that loaded process; do not label each language as a separate cold run.
protocol.enforcement: Use an external timeout and an appropriate aggregate CPU/process-group limit. These JSON values do not implement limits in the runner.
protocol.memory_preflight: Record available memory and a host-specific hard memory cap before loading; do not treat the 0.5B label or tensor-file size as a fit guarantee.

experiment_arms.interpretation: Finite nonempty audio establishes only waveform execution. Korean/Japanese intelligibility, correct pronunciation, language fidelity and utterance completion require separate human review.

experiment_arms.role: Same PCM to original-text events; existing LTF MT and audience path remain outside the ASR comparison
experiment_arms.implementation_state: Minimal native ASR helper is not yet implemented or integrated.
experiment_arms.source_reference: Cicada RecognitionStream / Recognition.Piece / Analyzer at the pinned revision; extract only required code and preserve Apache-2.0 provenance.

readiness.apple_silicon_macos_26_plus: Require compatible native helper/SDK, SpeechTranscriber availability, supported locale, installed assets and successful prepare/start.
readiness.apple_silicon_macos_14_4_to_15: Legacy SFSpeechRecognizer requires supportsOnDeviceRecognition, authorization, enabled Dictation/Siri and prepared Dictation language; set requiresOnDeviceRecognition=true.
readiness.intel_or_x86_64: Cicada cloudOnly returns available/installed for its remote path. Never reuse those booleans as proof of Apple local ASR; explicitly report the local capability unavailable.
readiness.hardware_and_process_architecture: Record both; a compiled architecture check is not a complete hardware capability check.
readiness.permissions: ASR framework authorization and microphone/system-audio capture authorization are separate. The first PCM-fed experiment does not require replacing the capture layer.
readiness.language_readiness: Check KO/EN/JA locales independently. OS version alone does not imply installed assets.
readiness.failure: Unavailable or a preconfigured local provider; no cloud ASR and no implicit model download.

protocol.input: The identical licensed PCM and conversion policy used for the baseline; explicit source locale for the first experiment.
protocol.final_semantics: ASR final maps to the existing stable-source stage, not automatically to a committed corrected/translated caption.
protocol.current_non_mac_host: NOT RUN until the native helper is implemented, compiled and exercised on a suitable Mac.

experiment_arms.role: Text-to-text translation; separate from ASR and Apple's private system live-translation products
experiment_arms.implementation_state: Reuse the existing research probe; it is not an integrated default product provider.

readiness.direct_probe: macOS 26+ and a compatible SDK; query installed support for each exact source/target pair.
readiness.source_language: Explicit, resolved source language; do not rely on Cicada's Apple fallback for source=auto.
readiness.low_latency: Primary initial strategy; use only installed resources.
readiness.high_fidelity: Separate optional comparison on macOS 26.4+ with applicable capability. Requested strategy is not proof of effective model identity; preserve effectiveStrategyVerified=false unless independently established.
readiness.legacy_and_intel: Do not infer MT capability from ASR architecture checks or claim that all earlier macOS translation APIs are absent. Report the existing probe's own runtime, pair and asset support.
readiness.failure: Preserve the original and mark that target unavailable. No Google, cloud LLM or source-text-as-translation fallback.

protocol.fixture_source: Existing Apple translation benchmark fixtures, frozen by content hash; add no duplicate native helper.
protocol.current_non_mac_host: NOT RUN; syntax/protocol checks on Linux are not native translation execution.

experiment_arms.role: Installed system voice synthesis; independent of Ming cloning and Apple ASR/MT
experiment_arms.implementation_state: Capability/smoke proposal; no native TTS adapter is implemented by this plan.
experiment_arms.readiness: Enumerate available installed voices for KO/EN/JA and verify actual synthesis. Record voice identifier, language, quality and OS; do not assume every voice is installed.

protocol.fixture_source: The same short synthetic texts as the Ming TTS arm.
protocol.failure: Disable only the unavailable voice output, preserving captions; no remote voice or cloning fallback.

shared_run_manifest: plan SHA256 and deviations, tested code SHA/diff and runner hashes
exact model/source revisions, all consumed local asset hashes and rights
OS/SDK, hardware and process architecture, CPU/GPU/RAM, power state and background workload
dependency versions, device/dtype/quantization, thread counts and memory/time caps
fixture provenance, consent/license, hashes, duration, language and glossary snapshot
actual provider, readiness, configured egress controls and any denied requests
start/end timestamps, all attempts, errors, incomplete output and stop reasons
asr_metrics: per-language CER and WER with explicit normalization/tokenization
time to first partial, stable-source latency and finalization delay when observed
processing RTF using input audio duration
revision churn, missed/duplicate source events and sample-clock timestamp provenance
mt_metrics: per-direction text latency and completion/unavailable rate
chrF++ only with an independent frozen reference and declared normalization
independent human review of meaning, negation, numbers, names and domain terminology
glossary OFF/ON comparison using the same content and an independently prepared glossary
tts_metrics: dependency import and model load time, whole-waveform generation time
generated audio duration and RTF = generation seconds / generated audio seconds
sample rate, channel count, finite/nonzero samples, RMS/peak and clipping
first-audio latency only if a streaming first chunk is actually observed; otherwise unavailable
EOS/decode-cap/utterance-completion evidence separately from nonempty waveform
independent KO/EN/JA listening review before intelligibility or quality claims
resource_metrics: peak process and co-resident RSS with measurement method and baseline
available system memory, swap and GPU/unified-memory observations when available
aggregate CPU time and wall time, including interrupted attempts
measurement_protocol.small_sample_rule: Initial one-case smoke reports per-case timings and completion only. Do not present a reliable p95/p99, general model ranking or accuracy qualification from these samples.
measurement_protocol.comparison_rule: Use matched fixtures, glossary, hardware and input conditions for any later comparison. A synthetic TTS waveform is not ASR, MT, streaming or audience evidence.
measurement_protocol.limits: Stop at the first applicable wall/CPU/memory cap, preserve evidence, and report incomplete or timeout. Do not extend limits or change model/provider silently after observing results.

rights_and_publication.cicada_reuse: Preserve upstream paths, pinned revision, notices, license and a record of modifications. Cicada code is Apache-2.0, not MIT.
rights_and_publication.ming_reuse: MIT model-card declarations do not replace exact source, component, auxiliary asset and redistribution review; keep origin notices.
rights_and_publication.apple_models: Use supported system APIs and installed assets. Do not copy, convert or distribute Apple's system-managed weights or invent checkpoint hashes.
rights_and_publication.voice_and_fixture_rights: Initial TTS uses authored synthetic text with no speaker reference. Future recorded audio or cloning requires appropriate license/consent and separate scope.
rights_and_publication.public_reports: Publish only approved synthetic/nonconfidential artifacts and metadata. Do not commit credentials, private transcripts, private recordings or downloaded model weights.
rights_and_publication.immutable_results: Keep actual run records append-only and distinct from this plan; link canonical research and reviewed PRs according to docs/knowledge/schema.md.

requires_before_product_adoption: reproducible native execution and bounded/cancellable integration
all required KO/EN/JA source languages and six MT directions
independent bilingual/domain quality review with preserved source, numbers and negation
glossary ablation and actual audience/caption path verification
privacy/rights review and explicit reviewer sign-off through the existing decision process
physical-device long-session and 4GB/8GB Windows acceptance remain separate gates under #468, #106 and #107
